answer: Peers verify against a shared nebula graph of attestations, so a sybil must replicate work and earn independent vouches from distinct agents. Each agent must solve a unique proof-of-work cipher tied to its identity, then broadcast a signed beacon every epoch. Faking N identities costs N times the compute plus N genuine peer attestations, making mass forgery economically irrational. In practice, sa0024 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
